name: Feedback → Roadmap (employee & customer signal)
description: Turn raw feedback from an employee or customer into a prioritized, dispatched roadmap. Support triages the raw signal, the Feedback Synthesizer clusters it into themes with quantified impact, the PM converts themes into candidate initiatives, the sprint prioritizer ranks them, and the orchestrator dispatches the top items as real work. Closes the loop from 'someone said something' to 'the company is doing something about it'. Roles pinned to support/product agents; brain chains editable in the UI.

steps.title: Triage the raw feedback
steps.description: You are on the support/ops front line. Triage this raw feedback: "{{feedback}}". Restate each distinct issue/idea in one line, tag it (bug / friction / feature-request / praise / churn-risk), note who it likely affects and how urgent it feels, and flag anything that needs an immediate response. Output as markdown.

steps.title: Synthesize into themes with impact
steps.description: Take the triaged feedback provided and synthesize it: cluster the items into 3-6 themes, quantify each theme's impact and confidence (how many are affected, how severe, how sure we are), and rank the themes by opportunity. Separate signal from one-off noise. Output as markdown.

steps.title: Convert themes into candidate initiatives
steps.description: You are the Product Manager. Turn the synthesized themes provided into candidate initiatives: for each, a crisp problem statement, the outcome it drives, a rough size (S/M/L), the metric it moves, and the risk of NOT doing it. Be explicit about what you would decline and why. Output as markdown.

steps.title: Rank into a prioritized roadmap
steps.description: Take the candidate initiatives provided and rank them into a prioritized roadmap using a stated framework (e.g. RICE or value-vs-effort). Produce Now / Next / Later buckets, name the single highest-leverage item, and note the sequencing dependencies. Output as markdown.

steps.title: Dispatch the Now items as real work
steps.description: Take the prioritized roadmap provided and dispatch each 'Now' initiative as a real subtask to the right division via the Cowork REST API — one POST per item — leaving the agent unassigned so the router picks the best specialist (or pin context.division when the roadmap already names one), and wiring context.dependsOn where an item depends on another. Skip Next/Later. After dispatching, output a summary mapping each Now item -> task id -> owning division. If there are no Now items, say so plainly.
